# One item. Every channel. See where the money actually lands.

> Free marketplace fee comparison: enter one item and see net profit after fees and returns on eBay, Etsy, Amazon, Mercari, Reverb and a dozen more.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
